chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about one who forgot to perform one sajdah and remembered it while he was standing.

He عليه السلام said: "He should perform it when he remembers it, so long as he has not bowed. But if he has already bowed, then let him continue with his salat (prayer), and when he finishes, he should make up that one alone. There is no sahw upon him."

key_terms.قَضَاهَا: he makes it up after the prayer
key_terms.يَسْجُدَ: to perform a prostration in the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forget one sajdah in salat (prayer) and only remember it while standing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about forgetting a single sajdah in salat (prayer). If the person remembers before going into ruku', he performs it immediately; if he remembers after ruku', he completes the prayer and then makes up the missed sajdah separately, without any additional sahw liability.
